exact_predicates.source: source repository/commit/tree must equal the immutable WS-50 source binding; source mutation=false
exact_predicates.candidate: all 40 candidate IDs must match the A3 metadata matrix; candidate_only=true; accepted=0; promotion_forbidden=true
exact_predicates.consumer_ref: each receipt must match its declared repository/branch/commit/tree/commit_tree_digest exactly
exact_predicates.provenance: receipt provenance must be PASS_EXACT_REPOSITORY_BRANCH_COMMIT_TREE and correspond to the declared consumer
exact_predicates.reviewer: review is recommendation-only and independently attributable; no authority or acceptance effect
exact_predicates.runtime: no live ESTRA execution, feature/catalog mutation, publication, DB, raw, cold or HOST_IO effect
exact_predicates.claim_ceiling: semantic-review-candidate-only; no science, dominance, publication, release or activation claim

after_retry_3_identical.route: OC14 router + WS-50 owner + affected consumer/reviewer

accept_or_return.accept_rule: Accept only when all 241 slots are non-null, exact-predicate matched, independently attributable and no fail-closed negative is active; acceptance remains profile/transport metadata only.

missing_routes.WS-60: 40 admission + 40 reviewer slots across WS-60 rows -> WS-60 Toolkit owner
missing_routes.WS-70: 40 admission + 40 reviewer slots across WS-70 rows -> WS-70 adapter/execution consumer owner
missing_routes.WS-75: 40 admission + 40 reviewer slots across WS-75 rows -> WS-75 Publication owner
missing_routes.independent_engineering_review: 1 profile-review receipt for all 40 rows -> independent engineering reviewer / WS-50 owner
